summary: JetPuan Market system fully tested. All 11 features verified: Admin tabs (Kategoriler, Ürünler, Siparişler, Ayarlar), Category CRUD, Product CRUD, Courier JetPuan Market tab, Balance display, Transaction history, Auto puan on hakediş, Cart functionality, Order creation with balance check, Admin order management, Puan ratio settings.
passed_tests: GET /api/jetpuan/products - Returns products with category names
Admin JetPuan Market page loads with 4 tabs
Admin Kategoriler tab shows 2 categories with edit/delete
Admin Ürünler tab shows product (Kablosuz Kulaklık - 50 JP)
Admin Siparişler tab shows orders with status
Admin Ayarlar tab shows puan ratio input (1.17)
Courier Market tab shows products with category filters
Courier Puan Geçmişi shows transaction history
Sepete Ekle button adds product to cart
Cart modal shows items with quantity controls
critical_code_review_comments: JetPuan auto-credit on hakediş working correctly (100 TL = 1.17 JP)
Balance validation prevents orders exceeding available points
Order cancellation properly refunds points and restores stock
Category deletion blocked when products exist in category
Transaction history shows both credits (hakediş) and debits (orders)
seed_data_creation: Test data: 2 categories (Elektronik, Giyim), 1 product (Kablosuz Kulaklık - 50 JP, Stock: 10), Courier balance: 11.87 JP from hakediş transactions
context_for_next_testing_agent: JetPuan Market system fully implemented and tested. Features: Admin can manage categories/products/orders/settings. Couriers earn JetPuan automatically when hakediş is entered (100 TL = 1.17 JP by default, configurable). Couriers can browse market, add to cart, place orders if balance sufficient. Admin can deliver or cancel orders. Order cancellation refunds points and restores stock.
